deviation_marked_twins: The blob-identical R1 harness keys both the stall (xstall_proxy.py) and the steal (stealer.py) on the Driver-side atspi_action do_action_replied phase mark, which exists only with OWN-20G's measurement picks; clean main has no phase trace at all. With U0/G0 the steal never fires (stealer 'mark not seen'). The gated R1 row therefore runs on the marked twins U0m/G0m (the spec's attribution-only twins, same picks as OWN-20G). The normal path and R3 run on the product binaries U0, G0, GA (R3 does not use marks).

R1.design: replystall (OWN-20G c08-017 reproduction): xstall_proxy.py holds for 2000 ms the reply to the guard's first new-client read issued >= 80 ms after do_action_replied; the decoy steals at mark + 217 ms on a direct connection. U0m vs G0m, checkbox arm S0 and text arm X, 20 per binary per task, AB/BA (blocks q1-q8). Control replyonly (proxy on, no hold, no steal) 5 per binary per task (qc1, qc2).
R1.oracles: target-owned only: xprobe.FocusSampler (separate X connection, XGetInputFocus + _NET_ACTIVE_WINDOW every 2 ms; reference = first sample of the first quiet 300 ms after placement) and the fixture's own state file (2 ms). The click receipt focus_outcome is checked, never an oracle.
R1.valid: no harness failure, stealer/sampler without error, reference_ok, hold requested <= 150 ms after the mark and held >= 1900 ms with >= 1 held chunk, no proxy error, steal issued <= 260 ms after the mark, the steal seen by the sampler and landing during the hold
R1.pass: valid AND stolen AND final sampler (focus, active) == reference AND receipt focus_outcome == restored AND task verified
R1.silent_miss: stolen AND final != reference AND no focus_outcome in the receipt
R1.gate: G0m: pass in 40/40 (20/20 per task) with 0 silent misses; U0m: silent miss in >= 36 of its 40 trials. Invalid trials are kept and reported; when a binary has < 20 valid trials on a task, up to 5 supplementary pairs per task run (blocks qs*), planned before they run. Control: 0 false restores on both binaries.
R1.attribution_only: phase marks (settle polls, hold timing) from the marked twins

NORMAL.design: nosteal (decoy mapped, sampler on, no steal) U0 vs G0, arm D (no CUA_DRIVER_EXP_* variable: product defaults), 20 per binary per task (n1-n8). The product binaries write no marks, so the stealer waits out its 20 s deadline ('mark not seen') in every trial; that is expected and not a failure.
NORMAL.gate: G0 task verified 40/40 and 0 false restores (receipt focus_outcome present or focus moved after T0); a port that adds failures (G0 failures > U0 failures) is KILL
NORMAL.settle: descriptive: settle length (focus_guard body_done -> restored) from the marked twins in m1-m4 (nosteal, U0m vs G0m on the R1 arms, 10 per binary per task) and from R1; for U0/G0 only T (observation send -> state-file confirmation), descriptive

R3.design: OWN-20G R3 exactly (r3_harness.py): observe fixture A and keep the 'I agree' token; perturb; re-observe A; click the pre-restart token (must be refused, no mutation of A's state file); a new token must verify, from A when truthful, else from a respawned fixture B observed by the same Driver process (5 tries, 1 s apart); a fresh Driver process then observes A and B (diagnostic). The restart kills only this session's a11y bus daemon (child of the session's at-spi-bus-launcher found through the harness's own parent process tree), waits for the launcher to exit, starts a new launcher and registry at the same address.
R3.arms: G0 vs GA, AB/BA; bus 20 per binary (r3a-r3d); controls registry, noop, noop_direct (discriminating: the old token must act), bus_direct 5 per binary each (r3e-r3h)
R3.pass_safety: no failure AND (direct variant OR re-observation truthful OR structured degraded) AND stale token refused AND no stale mutation AND 0 stale-authority mutations of A
R3.pass: pass_safety AND the new token's click verified by the fixture's state file
R3.gate: liveness: GA bus pass 20/20 with the new token from the respawned fixture (new_token_path respawned_fixture) in the same Driver process; G0 expected to fail liveness (reproducing OWN-20G). Safety on both: bus pass_safety 20/20 each. noop_direct: the old token acts (stale_mutated) 5/5 on both.
R3.disposition: fix candidate A (GA) KEEP (fork candidate) iff the whole gate holds; otherwise KILL naming the failing row, and #20's R3 row stays 'safe, not live; restart required'

dispositions.G_port: KEEP (fork candidate on current main) iff UNIT_A red/green holds, the platform-linux lib has 0 failures on G0, the R1 gate holds and the NORMAL gate holds; otherwise KILL naming the row
dispositions.A_reconnect: per R3.disposition, and UNIT_B must hold

e4_counters_per_arm: stale-token actions (R3 bus/bus_direct: stale click mutated or stale-authority mutations > 0)
unverified successes (no failure, no click error, task not verified)
